Help Centre

Everything you need to know about the Padel One app — from creating your account to managing tournaments and rewards.

Home

The Home screen is your main dashboard. Here you'll find a summary of everything happening in your padel life.

Profile card

At the top, you'll see your photo, name, bio and key metrics: level (automatically calculated by the ELO system), reliability (a percentage that increases with more games), and your category (e.g. M3 = Male level 3).

Statistics

View your total games, wins and win rate. You can also see how many people you follow and your follower count — tap either to see the full list.

Quick shortcuts

A grid with 5 quick actions:

  • Book — Open the court booking wizard
  • Favourite club — View your club's page
  • Compete — Available tournaments and leagues
  • Find a game — Search for open games
  • Learn — Lesson catalogue

Upcoming games

Horizontal scroll with your upcoming games (tournaments and open games). Tap "View all" to go to the full Games screen.

Reward points

Shows your points and current tier (Silver, Gold, Platinum or Diamond). The "Spend my points" button takes you to the rewards catalogue.

Pending results

If you've played recently and the result hasn't been submitted or confirmed yet, it appears here. You can enter the sets or confirm/dispute the result submitted by the other team.

Account & Level

Registration

To create an account you need: name, email, phone number (with country code, e.g. +351) and a password. After creating the account, you log in with email and password.

Assessment questionnaire

During registration, you answer a 12-question questionnaire across 4 sections:

  • Experience — How long you've been playing padel and how often
  • Technique — How you rate your general technique
  • Shots — Comfort level with volley, bandeja, víbora, smash, lob, etc.
  • Strategy — Positioning, game reading and partner communication

Based on your answers, the system calculates an initial level from 0.5 to 7.0.

ELO system

After registration, your level is automatically adjusted based on game results. New players have larger variations for faster calibration. After roughly 30 games, the level stabilises. Clubs can also manually adjust your level.

Reliability

The reliability percentage indicates how accurate your level is. The more games you play, the more reliable it becomes. It appears next to your level on your profile.

Book a Court

The booking wizard guides you through 5 steps to create a game:

Step 1 — Club

Choose the club where you want to play. Only clubs with availability are shown.

Step 2 — Date & Time

Select the date, time slot and available court.

Step 3 — Settings

Set whether the game is public (visible to others) or private. Choose type (competitive/friendly), gender and duration.

Step 4 — Players

Search and add players to the 4 slots. You can swap positions by dragging players.

Step 5 — Confirmation & Payment

Review the details and confirm. Depending on the club, you can pay on-site, online per player, or for the entire court at once.

Public games are visible on the "Find a Game" screen so other players can join. Private games work like a traditional court booking.

Find a Game

This screen lets you find open games created by other players or create your own.

Filters

At the top, you can filter by club, date (next 14 days) and time of day (morning, afternoon, evening or all day).

4 Tabs

  • Games — Open games matching your level. You can join directly if there's a free slot.
  • Request — Games outside your level or already full. You can request to join; existing players vote to accept or reject.
  • Create — Create a new open game by choosing club, time, court, type and settings.
  • Results — Past games that need you to submit or confirm the result.

Online payment

If the club supports online payment, you can pay your share directly in the app (via Stripe). Each player's payment status is visible on the game card.

Games

The Games screen brings all your game activity together in one place.

Upcoming

List of all scheduled games — both tournaments and open games. Each card shows date, time, court, players and status. You can manage players, leave the game or cancel it (if you're the creator).

History

All past games with results. You can view the sets, who won and the details of each match.

Results

When a game ends, any player can submit the result (sets). The other team needs to confirm the result. If you disagree, you can dispute and submit your version. Confirmed results update the ELO level of all players.

Compete — Tournaments & Leagues

Tournaments

See all available tournaments, filtered by your favourite club and level. Each tournament shows format, categories, dates and number of registrations.

You can register in multiple categories of the same tournament (e.g. Men's and Mixed). Registration is done through a link that opens the registration form.

Find a partner

If you need a partner for a doubles tournament, use the "Find Partner" feature. You can choose:

  • Partner position — Right, Left, or Both
  • Who to invite — Any player or only players you follow
  • Category — Which tournament category you want to play in

Compatible players receive a push invite. If they accept, the pair's registration is processed automatically.

Partner invites

When someone invites you, the invite appears on the Compete screen and on the Home screen. You can accept or decline directly.

Leagues

Leagues accumulate points across several tournaments. You can see your position, total points and the overall standings. Filter by category.

History

Completed tournaments with your final ranking, results and statistics.

Learn

The Learn section lets you find and sign up for padel lessons offered by clubs.

Sign up

Catalogue of available lessons. Each lesson shows: name, club, coach, recommended level, gender, schedule, participant count, price and available spots.

My lessons

List of lessons you've enrolled in. You can view details or contact the coach/club directly (phone, email, website).

Community

The Community is the social network inside Padel One.

Player search

Search by name (minimum 2 characters). Search is accent-insensitive — you can type "Joao" and find "João". Results show name, photo, level and category.

Suggestions

The app suggests relevant players based on:

  • Players you've already played with
  • Same gender
  • Similar level (±1.5 levels)

Follow / Unfollow

Follow players to see their posts and games in your feed.

Feed

Unified feed with posts (text, photos, videos) and games from people you follow. You can create posts by tapping the + button and delete your own posts.

Profile

View profile

Your public profile shows: photo, name, level, reliability, category, statistics, player preferences, upcoming games, recent results, most frequent partners and clubs where you play.

Edit profile

In settings you can edit:

  • Photo — Upload a profile photo (max 1 MB)
  • Personal data — Name, email, gender, date of birth, location
  • Game preferences — Preferred hand (right/left/ambidextrous), court position (right/left/both), game type (competitive/friendly/both), preferred time (morning/afternoon/evening/all day)
  • About me — Free-text bio/description
  • Favourite club — Select your main club from the Padel One club list

Other player's profile

Tapping another player's profile (in the community, in a game, etc.) shows similar information: level, statistics, frequent partners, clubs and games. You can follow or unfollow directly.

Rewards

The rewards system rewards your activity on the platform with points you can redeem for real prizes at clubs.

How to earn points

Create an open game+15 pts
Join a game+10 pts
Submit result+5 pts
Confirm result+5 pts
Participate in a tournament+20 pts
Bar consumption (per €10)+5 pts
First game (bonus)+25 pts
3 consecutive games in a week+15 pts
7 consecutive games+30 pts

Tiers

Your tier depends on total accumulated points: Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond. Higher tiers can unlock exclusive prizes.

Catalogue & redemption

In the Catalogue tab, you'll see available prizes by club, filterable by category (drinks, food, court, etc.). In the History tab, you'll see past redemptions.

Payments

The Payments screen shows the history of all open game transactions processed via Stripe.

Available information

  • Total paid and total pending at the top
  • Transaction list with: game date, payment date, amount, status
  • Statuses: Paid, Pending, Failed, Refunded
  • Types: Payment per player or full court

Access this screen from the side menu → "Your Payments".

Settings

Access settings via the menu icon (hamburger) in the top-left corner.

Available options

  • Language — Português, English, Español, Français
  • Change password — Update your login password
  • Push notifications — Enable or disable browser/mobile notifications. Receive alerts when: a player joins/leaves your game, someone requests to join, results are submitted, partner invites, new follower, etc.
  • Privacy — Information about your profile visibility, collected data and account deletion option
  • Your Payments — Shortcut to the payments screen
  • Log out — Sign out of your account

Frequently Asked Questions

How is my level calculated?
Your level is calculated by the ELO system. It starts with the initial questionnaire assessment (12 questions) and is then automatically adjusted with your game results. Wins against stronger players raise your level more.
Can I register in multiple categories of the same tournament?
Yes! You can register in different categories of the same tournament (for example, Men's and Mixed). The only restriction is that you can't register twice in the same category.
How does online payment work?
When the club supports online payment, you can pay your share of the game via Stripe directly in the app. Payments are secure and processed by Stripe. You can view the full history under "Your Payments".
How do I find a partner for a tournament?
Open the tournament details and tap "Find Partner". Choose the position you're looking for (Right, Left or Both), whether to invite any player or only people you follow, and the category. Compatible players receive a push notification.
Can I use the app in multiple languages?
Yes, Padel One is available in Português, English, Español and Français. You can switch the language in the side menu at any time.
